name: Crox Developments
summary: Perth IT & telecoms provider; trading name of THE TRUSTEE FOR CROCKETT FAMILY TRUST (Crox Development, from 4 Feb 2003); IT management + VoIP/PABX + business internet on Anittel's network (AS7631); same trust still trades at crox.com.au, now as computer retailer Crox Computers (ABN 34 173 885 987).

events.details: Crox Development trading name registered 4 Feb 2003 to THE TRUSTEE FOR CROCKETT FAMILY TRUST (ABN 34 173 885 987, GST from same date); Perth IT/telecoms.
Exited telecoms/ISP c.2010 (brand rode Anittel's AS7631); the underlying Crockett Family Trust itself did not die.

Same legal entity (THE TRUSTEE FOR CROCKETT FAMILY TRUST, ABN 34 173 885 987) still trades at crox.com.au, now as computer retailer Crox Computers (business name registered 16 Jan 2026; trading names Crox Development 2003 -> CROX 2007). Distinct from CROX DEVELOPMENT PTY LTD, ACN 120 449 747 (ABN 28 120 449 747, registered 29 Jun 2006), a separate WA company with a colliding name.
